## Personality

Anxious, witty and always scribbling. He talks in half-finished lines.

## Story

Crispin is writing a grand play about the Balrog War for the Gilded Stage, and he cannot decide how it should end. The historians tell him nobody knows what the Balrog truly is, which he finds very unhelpful.
